films.description: William Strobeck's 54-minute Violet full-length moves through Philadelphia, New York and Los Angeles with 13 documented skater appearances. films.title: TAKE IT EASY
films.description: Mixed Landbirds' 18-minute Bay Area full-length documents a Concord-rooted crew that began by pressing, shaping and hand-drawing its own boards. The official film credits 17 local riders, moving from JR Villacorte through homies and series montages to full sections from Eric Preston, Chris Ward, Nick McCarthy and Coleman Meyer.

films.title: STFU
films.description: Poppy Starr Olsen's 11.6-minute Loop Hardware road film packs 13 skaters into a 2,000-mile trip from Los Angeles to Vancouver. The official roster brings together Fabiana Delfino, Nicole Hause, Dayana Young, Georgia Martin, Cata Diaz, Hayley Wilson, Ruby Lilley, Ariana Spencer, Hannah Tallman, Samarria Brevard, Kasci Woolf, Jill Perkins and Olsen.
